text:
Marta: Heads-up — QBR with Siemens next Wed. Need partner scorecard + MDF ask finalized by EOD Tue.
Sam: Got it. What numbers are you thinking for MDF? need line-item justification for finance.
Liam: Draft deck uploaded: https://confluence.redwood/siemens-qbr-draft (comments open). High-level ask: $120k marketplace credits + $50k SI enablement = $170k total.
Nina: Suggest splitting enablement vs GTM spend. Put $30k pilot bucket for 2 sysint workshops, $20k for SI certification materials. Marketplace credits separate.
Marta: Sounds reasonable. Also need marketplace listing certification by Thu so we can include screenshots in the QBR. @deploy-bot any ETA on listing checks?
deploy-bot: Automated check results: marketplace checklist: 3/6 passed (billing, icons, contact). Outstanding: security questionnaire, privacy blurb. ETA: pending manual input.
Liam: I'll take the security questionnaire. Sam — can you provisionally sign off on $170k pending ROI slide?
Sam: Provisionally yes but need a short ROI table. Please include 18-month ARR uplift and payback. If numbers look off I might push to $140k.
Nina: Proposed ROI assumptions in the draft: 6 closed SI-led deals over 18 months, avg ACV $100k, 20% attribution to marketplace = ~$120k net new ARR. Will add sensitivity table.
Marta: Also proposing two scorecard changes for the QBR: add "SI enablement sessions completed" and "Marketplace TOFU conversions" as KPIs.
Liam: Proposed scorecard metrics (short):
```
- Deal referrals (SI -> Redwood): 5
- Marketplace conversions (trial -> paid): 12
- SI enablement sessions: 3
- Joint webinars / events: 2
```
Sam: +1 :thumbsup: This helps finance forecast MDF effectiveness.
Ana: Tagging in for ops flow. I can process MDF once deck + ROI slide + Confluence MDF request template is filled. Link the invoice flow and provide expected payment dates.
Marta: Plan: finalize ask by Tue EOD, Ana files MDF request Wed morning, internal dry-run QBR Thu afternoon. Can everyone confirm availability for Thu 3pm for the dry run?
Liam: 3pm works for me. I'll update deck and scorecard and call out line items.
Nina: Works. I'll prepare the workshop outline and T-shirt list (just kidding) but will add enablement milestones.
Sam: I'll review ROI numbers Mon morning and flag any adjustments.
Marta: Thanks — small action list: 1) Liam: update deck + security questionnaire (due Tue noon) 2) Nina: workshop plan + pilot budget split (due Tue EOD) 3) Sam: ROI signoff (Mon AM) 4) Ana: MDF template ready Wed AM.
Marta: If we hit these, we'll aim to present the finalized MDF ask in the QBR and request co-fund approval.
Liam: On it.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: QBR dry-run Thu 15:00 has been added to #partnerships calendar.
Ana: I'll prep the MDF submission checklist and post link.
Marta: Great — closing thread, will ping again if anything blocks.
